verification.method: Independent gate re-verification against the pinned source (git describe verified live = v0.27.1, HEAD 6e448d0ea9bf3d88d898b65449ca6dc2aec170ac). Two independent techniques beyond re-running the suite: (1) differential fuzzing of impl vs code EXTRACTED DIRECTLY FROM THE PIN FILE via ast.get_source_segment (not trusting the impl's own copy), and (2) side-by-side anchor reads of pin vs implementation, plus live behavioral probes driving the impl directly with expectations computed from the pin's algorithm/comments.

differential_fuzz.setup: function source extracted verbatim from the pin file with ast and exec'd; compared against uplink.check_stop_strings on randomized corpora (random texts over AND/DAN/STOP/BAN/X/ZZZ/AN fragments, random new_char_count 0..len, random stop-lists up to 4, include_in_output both)

both methods extracted from the pin file (update bound with the pin's own module-level check_stop_strings), exec'd onto a stub with a scripted decode_next; driven in lockstep with an equivalent impl subclass over randomized stop lists, min_tokens 0-3, include flags, random batch splits (1-3 tokens), random stop_terminated, interleaved random finished/delta get_next_output_text calls

differential_fuzz.setup: pin function extracted via ast and exec'd alongside the impl's, driven on a byte-level TokenizerLike seam with random prompts (1-8 ids) and random new-token streams (1-8 raw byte ids, covering multi-byte UTF-8 splits and out-of-vocab ids)
differential_fuzz.result: 1000 fuzz cases — 0 mismatches on (new_tokens, decoded_text, prefix_offset, read_offset)

dead sentinel (m20/m1): fed the pin's b'ENGINE_CORE_DEAD' single frame -> validate_alive raised EngineDeadError which propagated through outputs_queue -> get_output_async -> output_handler propagate_error -> consumer; ZERO ABORT frames sent — exactly the pin's own comment 'Engine is dead. Do not abort' (async_llm.py:L618)
